title: Princess Kaguya Trailer
content: Filmmaker Isao Takahata helped to create this delightful trailer for the film "Princess Kaguya" about the transformation of a tiny princess into a regular human baby. The watercolor-come-to-life style is different for Studio Ghibli, the Japanese animation company best known forHayao Miyazaki's films"My Neighbor Totoro" and "Spirited Away." (Link to video).A commentary by Adam Bellotto inFilm School Rejectscompares the new trailer to the CGI animation of the big American studios. Thanks,Bryn
